clip_b32_logit_scale.why_it_matters: the strict-freeze control freezes every parameter except LoRA A/B, so this pretrained value is the temperature both experiments train under; it does not enter CG/DG/R@1 at all

dinov2_preprocessor.note: shortest_edge 256 -> centre-crop 224 is DINOv2's own eval geometry, so image_size=224 is NOT an out-of-distribution resolution by itself; the mean/std differ from CLIP's and src/dataset.py:19-20 uses CLIP's

clip_preprocessor.source: src/dataset.py:19-20 CLIP_MEAN/CLIP_STD used for every image
clip_preprocessor.geometry: Resize((224,224), BICUBIC)  -- note: not the shortest-edge-256 crop that either model's own preprocessor uses

trainable_params_closed_form.note: both towers are 12-layer, text hidden 512, vision hidden 768

paper_frozen_reference.why_it_matters: the paper's strict-freeze control records no frozen-baseline CG/DG/R@1 at all (experiments/strict_freeze_control.py:312-339 only writes effective rank + backbone_delta), so the paper's Delta-CG column is a within-run final-minus-initial quantity and the frozen model's retrieval has no archive source
